title: Terminology Mechanism For Plugin UI Labels
description: Introduce a "terminology" mechanism: every UI has a native terminology by default, and languages can define alternative complete term sets. Ship a "reuse"/"Wiederverwendung" terminology for puzzle 3d where "Objects"/"Vortices" become "Building components"/"Connection points" (en) and "Baukomponenten"/"Verbindungspunkte" (de). Add a Terminology dropdown to the OS Settings panel next to the existing Language dropdown. Implementation: ViewState gains locale/terminology fields passed from the OS shell into the plugin WASM boundary; AppDefinition gains a terminologies list; puzzle 3d resolves a compile-time-complete label struct per (terminology, locale) and remaps its emitted UiNode labels.
summary: Introduced a "terminology" mechanism: every UI has an implicit "native" terminology, and apps can declare additional named term sets that swap domain vocabulary in plugin-rendered labels, independent of (but combinable with) UI locale. Threaded locale/terminology from the OS shell through ViewState into the WASM plugin boundary (framework/core/rs ViewState + AppDefinition.terminologies, framework/plugin/rs AppBuilder.terminology()), fixed every AppDefinition struct-literal site the compiler then required (core tests, wgpu renderer tests, os-core registrations). Shipped puzzle 3d's "reuse"/"Wiederverwendung" terminology: a compile-time-complete Puzzle3dLabels struct with native/reuse × en/de consts and an exhaustive resolver, threaded through build_document_tree/build_kinds_tree/build_inspector_tree/select+brush measure groups, remapping "Objects"→"Building components"/"Baukomponenten" and "Vortices"→"Connection points"/"Verbindungspunkte" (left the object_kind data default and generic Delete/Duplicate context-menu labels untouched, since those aren't UI vocabulary). Added 4 new Rust tests asserting each terminology×locale combination; all 54 puzzle-plugin tests pass. Extended the ui-kit i18n layer (ui.chrome.terminology storage, UiChromeTerminologyId, ui.settings.tab.terminology + ui.settings.terminology.{native,reuse} schema keys with a new AssertUiSettingsTerminologyKeysCovered compile-time guard) and wired a Terminology dropdown into the OS Settings panel next to Language, populated from the active app's declared terminologies (always including native). Verified via cargo check/test (zero new errors; the 7 pre-existing compose-hub session_kit visibility errors and other pre-existing repo-wide type errors are untouched/unrelated), ui-react and root tsc (zero terminology-related errors, error counts unchanged from before this change), both packages' vitest suites (renderer-react 69/69; ui-react's 9 pre-existing unrelated failures untouched), and end-to-end in the running puzzle-3d playground (port 6013): all four combinations (native/reuse × en/de) correctly retranslate the Document tree, Catalogue tree, and window measures live, confirmed via screenshots.
